author: reek
body: Vertical slice for the Game-World Design Tool: canonical entities emitted three ways -- Stable Diffusion prompt, D&D 5e block, and a Magic: the Gathering card -- side by side, all derived from one system-neutral abstraction. Two entities of different kinds (Excalibur, a weapon; Merlin, a character) prove the model generalizes: the SAME emitters dispatch on the tagged abstraction. Static (authored in WorldModel); panels are filled via dom-set-html from the emitters after the shell mounts.
